a little piece of my heart, for youS

My darling Sanvi,

I could have sent you a simple “Happy Princess Day,” but I wanted to give you something you could stay inside for a little while. A little place where every word is for you, and every surprise is my way of saying: you matter so much to me.

When I call you my princess, I don’t mean you have to be perfect. I mean I want to care for you in the small, everyday ways. I want to hear the long version of your day, the tiny thing that made you smile, and the thought you almost kept to yourself.

You don’t have to find the right words with me, baby girl. I want to listen when you have a lot to say and sit beside you when you don’t. I want you to feel loved without having to earn it by being okay all the time.

And if you ever wonder why I made all of this, it’s simple: I wanted to make you smile. I wanted you to pause for a moment and feel how much you mean to me. I made every little bit for you, Sanvi.

Happy Princess Day, my highness.
I’m so glad I get to love you.

Always yours,me. ♡
P.S. If you’re smiling right now, that’s all I wanted.
